picks.title: for the one who wants an unforgettable life | For Strength of Youth Sep. 27 | ThisIsKingdom
picks.summary: What does it actually mean to live an unforgettable life?This week on This Is Kingdom, we dive into Chapter 9, Lesson 4 and explore how discovering our purpose in God’s work can bring lasting happiness, confidence, and connection with Jesus Christ.From Oliver Cowdery’s “days never to be forgotten” to Emma Smith discovering her own divine role in Doctrine and Covenants 25, we talk about what happens when we stop questioning whether we’re enough and start believing what God says about us.God wants to bless lives—and He wants us to be part of it. picks.reason: Explores living a purposeful life through God's work and restoration.

picks.summary: Why choose Christ? Because He is real! He is the most real thing in this world.
